segments.name: Video sharing platform and cloud services
segments.description: Operates a video sharing, livestreaming and cloud services platform selling advertising, subscriptions and creator tools to creators, advertisers, publishers and users.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as one operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Advertisers pay for display and video advertising, while users pay for subscriptions, pay-per-view and tipping, with revenue shared with creators.
revenueModel.evidence: We share revenue generated from advertising, subscriptions, pay-per-view and tipping with creators in a revenue-share model.
